extracted.stage: Financial remedy proceedings, first appointment listed
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for the husband in financial remedy proceedings at Bristol Family Court enquires about roughly £21,000 of funding for costs to conclusion, against matrimonial assets of about £1,253,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client in the financial remedy proceedings at Bristol Family Court. We have noted the estimated costs to conclusion of £21,000, the matrimonial assets of approximately £1,253,000 and the first appointment listed for 30 October. To take this further we would need details of your client's interest in and title to the assets in dispute, any existing charges or encumbrances, a costs estimate broken down by stage, confirmation of your client's identity and address, and an outline of the current position in the proceedings. A member of the team will review the information and come back to you with any further questions. Nothing in this message should be taken as an indication of whether funding can be offered or on what terms.
